pendulum.independent_external_region_support: Noda City documents the white morph in the Kanto Plain, especially Tone/Edo river floodplains, and reports early-summer flowering versus ordinary autumn-flowering C. pendulum.
pendulum.range_guard: NMNS describes ordinary C. pendulum in Japan from Nagano northward and Hokkaido. Therefore isolated Gifu/Shiga exact-form GBIF rows are not promoted to sampling anchors without specimen/taxonomic verification.
pendulum.sampling_decision: Keep two existing white slots P009/P010. Prioritize two distinct verified Kanto white-morph niche contexts where feasible (lowland Tone/Edo floodplain cluster versus an independent inland/northern-Kanto context), then geographically match P011/P012 coloured populations only where flowering periods overlap.
pendulum.aim2_guard: No flowering overlap means the pair is not used as a direct pollinator-choice comparison, although it may remain useful for Aim1/Aim3 ancestry and colour mechanism.

sieboldii.source_backed_state: Cirsium sieboldii f. leucanthum / white-flowered plants exist, but no exact-form public locality survived the conservative GBIF audit.
sieboldii.sampling_decision: Keep P013/P014 only. The second matched W/C pair (+2 populations, +30 individuals) remains conditional and untriggered until a verified white-morph locality can be placed relative to P013/P014.

claim_boundary: Named-form occurrence records are public locality hypotheses, not proof of current population persistence or permission. Exact collection sites remain field-verified. Single records that conflict with authoritative range descriptions are verification targets rather than sampling anchors.
